finding: In Tabari's direct explanation of 108:3, shani'aka means Muhammad's hater and enemy; al-abtar is the lesser and more abased one, cut off in his continuation/posterity, with no offspring. The direct explanation ends before Tabari begins listing reported identifications of the referent.

evidence_mapping.translation_proposal: By “your hater,” He means the one who hates you, Muhammad, and is your enemy. “He is al-abtar” means the lesser and more abased one, whose continuation is cut off and who has no offspring.
evidence_mapping.note: The direct lexical definition is not merged with later reports identifying particular historical opponents.
